notes: Needs the article (Springer, doi:10.1007/BF00004941, via a library login). Stand-in read: Treasurer, J. W. 1997, 'A review of recent research on the percids, perch Perca fluviatilis L. and ruffe Gymnocephalus cernuus (L.), in Scotland', Glasgow Naturalist 23: 41–48 (CC BY-NC; https://archive.org/download/biostor-224890/biostor-224890.pdf). It does NOT support either claim (no egg viability, no hatch-to-pelagic survival). What it does give, from Treasurer 1983 (p. 43): adult perch 4.8–9.7 per ha in Loch Kinord and 5.5 per ha in Loch Davan, production 0.32–0.39 and 0.20 kg/ha/yr; both lochs shallow (mean depth 1.5 m), perch and pike only. The research note (egg_survival_and_larval_production.md) says its Treasurer 1983 values came from a Springer abstract page saved by a helper; until the article is read the paper should keep '(abstract)', as it does.
